plan.title: Pre-call logistic baseline with balance and history absence diagnostics
plan.hypothesis: Logistic regression with C=1 provides a transparent reference for pre-call subscription prediction using eligible account, schedule and prior-history inputs. Establish current development evidence before comparing a tree family; historical results do not establish this run's performance.
plan.expected_learning: Establish baseline average precision, ROC-AUC, Brier score and log loss on the fixed subset using two shared, seeded stratified three-fold CV repeats. Fit imputation, numeric scaling and nominal categorical encoding within training folds; use no class weighting. Treat day_of_week as nominal without inventing calendar semantics. Exclude duration because it is post-call and campaign because its pre-call availability is unverified. Save splits and held-out predictions for paired comparisons. Examine frozen-model sensitivity to the listed source-column stresses using documented training-fold replacements; these do not establish complete history-loss robustness because poutcome remains available. Report probability-bin counts, mean predictions and observed frequencies separately by repeat where supported. Interpret results as descriptive development evidence, not independent test performance or deployment validation.

blocks: paired development comparison; external confirmation pending
